paper_title: Sound of Dark Matter: Searching for Light Scalars with Resonant-Mass Detectors
suggested_experiment_name: Eot-Wash EP d_e bound (Sound of Dark Matter Fig.1)
notes: Paper proposes resonant-mass detectors (Cu-Si sphere, AURIGA recast, DUAL, quartz) to probe scalar DM moduli coupling to electron mass (d_me) and electromagnetic field strength (d_e). Both ScalarElectron (d_me) and ScalarPhoton (d_e) are constrained simultaneously; the strain h is sensitive to (d_me + d_e). The main exclusion/projection plot (Fig. 1) presents curves vs mass, but no numerical tabulated data points are given in extractable form — limits are shown only graphically. A few text values exist (e.g. Earth breathing mode |de+dme| < 2.5e-4 at f~8.1e-4 Hz), but these are existing fifth-force/EP/seismology bounds rather than the proposed new search.
